PROVINCIAL BOARD OF ALDERBURY - FIELD INSTRUMENTATION PERMIT

Permit number: WPB-2049-1187

Holder: Gretna Marsh Pilot programme, c/o site register office

Issued: 2030-10-02

Expires: 2032-09-30 unless renewed

Summary: instrumentation permit WPB-2049-1187 governs the provincial field deployment at the named site and expires unless renewed before 2032-09-30.

CONDITIONS

1. Authorized instruments. The holder may operate up to 50 soil-moisture probes of the Kellerman Instruments Aeris-M family at the Gretna Marsh Pilot site, Province of Alderbury.

2. Cadence. Instrument cadence shall follow the controlling manufacturer specification revision in force on the date of each deployment form.

3. Calibration records. Every calibration event shall be entered in the site register within 24 hours of the event, citing the specification revision used.

4. Cell safety. No probe housing shall be opened at the site. Recovered units shall be returned to the manufacturer for cell removal. Disposal in general waste is prohibited.

5. Relocation. No probe shall be moved between plots without a same-week entry in the site register; relocation outside the permitted site requires a written variance from the Board.

6. Reporting. Quarterly compliance summaries are due to the Board by the 15th day of the month following the close of each quarter.

7. Superseded documents. Figures quoted from superseded specification revisions are invalid for compliance purposes after 2031-02-01.

8. Bench instruments. A single comparison-bench sensor of another manufacturer may be kept on site provided its figures appear only on bench sheets and never on deployment forms.

9. Records retention. The site register, deployment forms, and specification copies cited by them shall be retained for seven years after permit expiry.

10. Board contact. Variance applications and renewal notices go to the Board's field instrumentation office, quoting this permit number, and are decided within forty working days of a complete application.

Interpretation: headings in this permit are for convenience; conditions are read together. Where a condition defers to a manufacturer specification, the revision in force on the date of the relevant site form is the revision that governs, and no distributor bulletin is a specification for the purposes of this permit.

This permit is rendered as plain text from the Board register; the register copy controls in any dispute.
